objective: Win share plus a quarter of finishing position; a fallen empire is a loss for everyone.

opponents.label: Usurper
opponents.description: Wants the purple for itself. Pulls troops back to Constantinople whenever the frontier looks safe enough and gambles on seizing the throne.

opponents.label: Opportunist
opponents.description: Lets the others bleed at the frontier. Keeps its troops and gold for its own schemes and only fights when the empire is truly about to fall.

opponents.label: Landlord
opponents.description: Builds estates wherever they pay and lives off the rents. Often leaves the frontier to others and cares little who wears the crown.

opponents.label: Kingmaker
opponents.description: Never claims the throne itself and always does its part at the frontier. Backs whichever claimant will pay best in offices, and remembers who kept their word.

opponents.label: Tyrant
opponents.description: Takes power and uses it. Will strip the frontier bare to seize the throne, keeps offices for itself, strips rivals of theirs, and never forgets a slight.

opponents.label: Patron
opponents.description: Rules through favours. Hands offices to allies and backers, builds a coalition, and expects loyalty in return.

opponents.label: Miser
opponents.description: Hoards gold. Dismisses most of its troops for gold, buys little, and leaves the war and the throne to others.

opponents.label: Hoarder
opponents.description: Keeps every office it can for its own dynasty and strips rivals of theirs, even when the empire raises fewer troops for it.

opponents.label: Saboteur
opponents.description: Defends only where its own estates stand, and lets provinces fall when rivals it dislikes, or the leader, hold land or offices there.

opponents.label: Regicide
opponents.description: Undermines any Basileus it wants gone: holds back from the war to load Unrest on the throne, then backs a rival claimant in the coup.

opponents.label: Glory Hunter
opponents.description: Fights hard at the frontier to be the best defender, then spends the gold and Triumph on seizing the throne.

opponents.label: Strategist
opponents.description: No fixed temperament. Weighs every move by how much it raises its own chance to win: it defends when it must and goes for the throne when the odds are good.
